verdict.rationale: Raygun lets you mark a fixed error as 'Resolved' and claims deployment tracking can 'identify any new errors or regressions', and it offers alerts via email, Slack or Teams. Nothing shows that a resolved error which recurs in a newer release triggers its own alert, separate from new-issue alerts. missing for 10: documented reopen/regression behavior for resolved errors tied to a release version, a regression-specific alert type distinct from new-error alerts, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, I get alerted when an error that was fixed comes back in a newer release, distinct from ordinary new-issue noise

citations.quote: Track every deployment in real time to identify any new errors or regressions.
Once you've fixed a particular error, you can mark an it as 'Resolved'.
Alerts via email, Slack or Teams.
